privacy.title: Privacy notice
privacy.who: OopsProof is a free personal project run by {owner}. Questions or requests: {contact}.
privacy.what: Your email, Name, Surname, profile photo if you add one, time zone, currency, your Items, Reminders, Expenses and the devices you allow to get push. We never ask for full card or document numbers.
privacy.why: Only to remind you before things are due and to show your spending. Nothing else.
privacy.where: Your data is kept by Supabase in Frankfurt (EU). The app is served by Cloudflare. Login emails are sent through Gmail. Push messages pass through your browser's push service (Google, Apple or Mozilla). Encrypted backups may be stored outside the EU.
privacy.howLong: Until you delete your account, or after 12 months without use (we email you 30 and 7 days before). A deleted account disappears from our backups within 30 days.
privacy.rights: You can see, change and delete your data in the app at any time. For a copy of your data, email {contact} and you will get it within 30 days.
privacy.noTracking: No ads, no tracking, no selling. We use no analytics and only the storage that logging in needs, so there is no cookie banner.
